featured_reviews.name: DM
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Leeyan is good, but there is a lack of transparency in the group sessions. We do not receive updates on how our kids are doing, what activities they participated in, or how they performed and responded. This lack of information feels concerning. Additionally, after every session, the same four words are written in the file, and this repetition occurs daily, making it difficult to gauge any real progress.
Suggestion: To improve transparency and keep parents informed, consider installing a camera in the session room and live-streaming the sessions to an accessible area outside. This would allow parents to observe their children's engagement and development firsthand and receptionist needs to be more polite especially towards kids.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are unable to identify you as a parent of any kid coming to us as there is lack of transparency in your identify but still would like to answer your suggestions: firstly, know that therapy sessions are confidential and cannot be live streamed at any cost although we have cctv all across the clinic inclufing therapy rooms. Secondly, as you have yourself mentioned that we do write notes after every session that means we are updating you after every session. And thirdly, writing same three points in session notes is because we mention the areas that we worked on and we aim to achieve, that’s pre planned as per the goals. Thank you for the efforts taken to write this feedback!

featured_reviews.name: Pritam Chavan-Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have had such a wonderful experience with Dolly, my son’s occupational therapist, and I can’t thank her enough for the incredible progress he has made under her care. From the very beginning, Dolly approached my son’s needs with compassion, patience, and professionalism. She took the time to understand his personality, his challenges, and what strategies would work best to help him succeed—not just in therapy sessions, but in everyday life.

My son struggles with hyperactivity, writing, reading, and far point copying, and Dolly has been instrumental in helping him build the skills he needs to feel more confident and capable. She has a special gift for making learning fun and engaging, using creative techniques that hold his attention and keep him motivated. Whether it was fine motor activities, visual tracking exercises, or sensory-based strategies, Dolly always made sure the sessions were personalized and effective.

One of the most amazing parts of this journey has been watching my son develop a genuine excitement for writing and reading—two areas that used to be sources of stress. Dolly’s consistent encouragement, gentle redirection, and positive energy helped him stay focused and proud of his progress. His far point writing, which used to be a big challenge, has improved significantly thanks to her structured and supportive approach.

Dolly has made a lasting impact on our lives, and I would wholeheartedly recommend her to any parent looking for an exceptional occupational therapist. She’s truly one of a kind, and we feel so lucky to have her support.

The major concern I had was speech for my son and I see that from two need based words he is now trying to speak in three word sentences meaningfully.

Also special mention to Santoshi Mam who works very closely with my son. She works with all her heart and the efforts she has put we can see in our son.

The team at Atman has also guided us with a Home Program and support us in achieving faster results through it.

Truly grateful for Dolly Mam and her team. My search for a home away from home for my son ends at Atman!
